verses.text: This is the message of judgment against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw.
Raise a flag on a bare hilltop! Shout to the soldiers! Wave your hand to signal them to march through the gates of the nobles.
I have given orders to my chosen soldiers. Yes, I have called my warriors to carry out my anger, those who celebrate my victory with pride.
Listen to the noise on the mountains, like the noise of a huge crowd! Listen to the uproar of kingdoms, of nations gathering together! The LORD of Armies is gathering an army for battle.
They come from a faraway land, from the ends of the sky. The LORD and the weapons of his anger are coming to destroy the whole land.
Cry out, for the day of the LORD is near! It will come like destruction from the Almighty.
So every hand will hang down weak, and every heart will melt with fear.
They will be terrified. Pain and sorrow will grab them. They will twist in pain like a woman giving birth. They will look at each other in shock, their faces burning red.
Look, the day of the LORD is coming, a cruel day of fury and fierce anger. It will make the land a wasteland and destroy the sinners in it.
The stars of the sky and their groups will not give their light. The sun will be dark when it rises, and the moon will not shine.
I will punish the world for its evil, and the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the pride of the arrogant and humble the pride of the cruel.
I will make people harder to find than pure gold, rarer than the gold of Ophir.
So I will make the heavens shake, and the earth will be shaken out of its place, because of the fury of the LORD of Armies on the day of his fierce anger.
Like a hunted gazelle, like sheep with no shepherd to gather them, everyone will go back to their own people and run away to their own land.
Everyone who is found will be stabbed. Everyone who is caught will die by the sword.
Their babies will be smashed to pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be robbed, and their wives will be raped.
Look, I will stir up the Medes against them, who do not care about silver and do not desire gold.
Their bows will strike down the young men. They will have no pity on babies and will not spare the children.
Babylon, the most glorious of kingdoms, the beauty and pride of the Babylonians, will be destroyed by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
No one will ever live there again, generation after generation. No Arab will set up a tent there, and no shepherds will rest their flocks there.
Instead, wild desert animals will lie down there, and its houses will be full of jackals. Owls will live there, and wild goats will leap about there.
Hyenas will howl in its towers, and jackals in its beautiful palaces. Its time is almost here, and its days will not last much longer.
